mint_class: roaming-persistent-AoE (autonomous self-propelled damage field that pathfinds/wanders forward)
description: A persistent AoE that MOVES autonomously across the battlefield under its own motion after being cast -- not a projectile that travels-then-ends, not a stationary ground patch, not an orbit tethered to the caster. poe2-twister: '0.5m radius vortex moving forward ERRATICALLY at 7.5m/s; lasts 3 seconds; Blinds and repeatedly Hitting enemies within'. The engine's 26-geometry set has projectile (travels straight/homes), ground_targeted_circle (static patch), orbit (caster-tethered spin), whirlwind (caster-centered spin) -- but NO member for a decoupled, self-navigating, persistent-duration damage FIELD that roams the arena independent of the caster's position. Mapped un-minted as multi_projectile (several discrete roaming twisters) + an R-M8 wander/pursuit behavioral note; grade APPROX (the erratic-roaming IS a large part of the kit's felt identity, though multiple twisters + a spread approximation keep it above GAPPED).
